fusions.name: Basking Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 18 damage to a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage. It has 50% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.

fusions.name: Twin Flicks
fusions.desc: Flicks 2 cold lashes at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage and having a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Held Still
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 3 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Warm Hours
fusions.desc: In daylight, you deal 12% more damage. You have 5% more dodge chance.
